contract: Sahabat Belajar (SLB B-C Wijayakusumah) Auth & Student Home Design Contract. Includes bg.png login suite and special-needs friendly /beranda featuring 2+3 symmetrical bento grid, Montessori flat picture-book SVG illustrations (non-anime), tap-only greeting speech assist, and calm/contrast theme support.

responsive.evidence: Student home grid adapts from 6-column symmetrical 2+3 bento desktop layout to balanced 2-column tablet (5th tile spanning full row) to 1-column mobile cards without horizontal overflow.

loading.evidence: Server-rendered Blade views and crisp inline vector art load immediately without spinner or flicker.

empty.evidence: Empty states in child modules remain polite and clear.

error.evidence: Error pages and form validation alerts stay calm and consistent.

partial.reason: Home dashboard displays fixed 5 core modules synchronously.

success.evidence: Attendance recorded state highlights ABSEN card with green border and 'Sudah Hadir' pill verified by StudentLearnTest and AttendanceAndReportTest.

permission.evidence: Student role middleware protects /beranda and returns calm 403 screen for unauthorized roles.
